channel.title: Holistic Life: Outdoor Walking and Cardio Workouts
channel.description: Outdoor Walking and Cardio Workouts guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Gifts for Him: 10 Useful Ideas for a Man Who Walks
item.description: Gifts for him get easier when he loves to walk. Ten ideas that keep a walker warm, dry and easy to see on dark mornings: cushioned socks, gloves and an ear warmer, clip-on lights, a packable rain jacket and more, plus why shoes are better left to a gift card. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking in Winter: Gear and Gift Ideas for Dark Evenings
item.description: Walking in winter is easier with the right gear, and it makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who walks on dark evenings. These ideas help them stay visible, warm and dry, from reflective vests to gloves and a packable jacket. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking for Beginners: How Fast to Walk Using the Talk Test
item.description: Walking for beginners is easier when you know your pace. Use the talk test: you can talk but not sing. This guide explains it, then gives a 4 week walking workout plan with rest days and what to do when you miss one. Guide contains affiliate links.
